name: Hide Beat Grid
author: dnlsndr
summary: Hides the waveform beat rulers for beatmatching practice.
description:
Clears EP147's 1220x15 beat-ruler images above and below the waveforms. The waveform, BPM, cues and audio are unchanged; you can practice matching by ear without using the grid.

The core owns makeGridImage when Bright Grid/Day Mode is active, so the mod writes settings/azmod-gridaa.off and needs one Reload after installation to claim the hook. Bright Grid and Day Mode cannot be used at the same time.
